description: This file implements the main front-end component for a Tic Tac Toe game, including game logic, UI rendering, state management, and animations, with support for single and multiplayer modes.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Determines if the current board state has a winner, a draw, or is ongoing.

methods.name: computeAIMove
methods.description: Computes the optimal move for the AI player based on current board state.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component that manages game state, handles user interactions, and renders the game UI.

methods.name: WinningLine
methods.description: Component that renders an overlay line over the winning combination on the board.

methods.name: LineOverlay
methods.description: Component that visually overlays the winning line with animations and styling depending on the winning combo.
